title: Credential key filter must run on the key before the value is sanitized
answers: which crewai keys are dropped from traces
why does max_tokens disappear or stay in crewai trace
credential-like field names in crewai autolog
auth_token or client_secret showing in crewai span
body:
Invariant: Span attributes written by crewai autolog must skip credential-named keys using _SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN before calling _sanitize_value. A plain string under a key such as auth_token is not recognized by _sanitize_value, so the key itself is the only signal.
The pattern matches api_key/apikey, secret, password, authorization, and credential anywhere in the key, plus token only as a snake_case standalone or suffix word or a camelCase Token suffix. So max_tokens, tokenizer, and token_usage are kept.
Enforced in: mlflow/crewai/autolog.py:_SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN, checked in _set_sanitized_attribute, _get_agent_attributes, _get_task_attributes, and _get_llm_attributes, and _sanitize_value drops the same keys in dicts.
Breaks if skipped: a credential stored under a non-api_key name such as client_secret or accessToken is written to the trace unchanged.
applies: Applies when adding or renaming any CrewAI object field that could hold a credential, or when editing the key pattern.
says: Authentication secrets and client tokens are visible inside agent execution trace details.
Hide sensitive credential fields when viewing automated agent traces on the dashboard.
Token usage and generation counts should stay visible in recorded execution traces.
Client secrets and passwords appear in plain text within task trace attributes.
search: Span attributes in CrewAI autolog must filter credential keys using _SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN before invoking _sanitize_value because string values like auth_token lack value-level detection. The pattern matches api_key, apikey, secret, password, authorization, and credential anywhere, but matches token only standalone or as a suffix, preserving max_tokens, tokenizer, and token_usage. Checked in mlflow/crewai/autolog.py across _set_sanitized_attribute, _get_agent_attributes, _get_task_attributes, and _get_llm_attributes, and used when dropping dict keys in _sanitize_value.
